source.quote: use a schema that accepts anything when contract has no input schema

obligations.statement: For a contract with no input schema, implementToolFactory()(oc) returns a tool whose inputSchema validates any value unchanged (validate({ anything: true }) gives { value: { anything: true } }) and whose draft-07 JSON schema is {} for both input and output.
For a contract with a single input schema, implementToolFactory()(contract, { execute }) returns a tool whose inputSchema is that same schema object.
implementToolFactory()(contract, { execute }) returns a tool whose execute is the very function passed in, not a wrapper.
When no description option is given, implementToolFactory()(contract) takes the tool's description from the contract's aiSdkTool meta.
A description passed in the tool options overrides the description from the contract's aiSdkTool meta.
implementToolFactory()(contract, options) carries the metadata from the contract's aiSdkTool meta, such as { source: 'weather-service' }, onto the tool.
once(fn) calls fn only on the first call and returns that same first result on every later call.

source.quote: Executes the callback function after the current call stack has been cleared.

obligations.statement: defer(callback) never runs the callback synchronously; it runs it after the current call stack has cleared, so code that follows the defer call runs first.
Even when globalThis.setTimeout is undefined at the time of the call, defer(callback) still runs the callback later rather than synchronously, after code that follows the defer call.
tryOrUndefined(fn) returns undefined instead of throwing when fn throws.
tryOrUndefined returns falsy results of fn unchanged: false, 0, '' and null come back as themselves, not as undefined.
